summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase B feature enhancements for IronVision GRC. All 19 backend tests passed (100%). All 17 frontend test cases passed. Features tested: Dashboard widget customization (show/hide, reorder), Framework grid organization (show/hide, reorder), Implementation & Guidelines tab with AI guidance generation, Enhanced AI Policy Suggestion with 'Where Requirements Are Met' and 'Gaps' sections, SIEM events mapped to NIST CSF and GDPR frameworks, Expand All/Collapse All for controls.

issues: Console warnings about 'Invalid prop supplied to React.Fragment' - cosmetic only, does not affect functionality

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase B feature enhancements complete and verified. Dashboard has widget customization (localStorage key: iv_dashboard_widgets). Frameworks page has organize panel (localStorage key: iv_framework_prefs). Framework workspace has Expand All/Collapse All button, Implementation & Guidelines tab with Generate Guidance button, and enhanced AI Policy Suggestion showing satisfied/gaps sections. SIEM events now map to NIST CSF (27 technical controls) and GDPR (7 technical controls) in addition to NIST 800-53.

login.details: Login with demo-admin@grc.com / DemoAdmin123! works correctly

dashboard_customize_panel.details: Customize panel shows all 5 widgets with up/down arrows and eye toggle

widget_visibility_toggle.details: Toggling a widget hides/shows it on the dashboard

widget_reorder.details: Moving a widget up/down changes its position

dashboard_widgets_render.details: All 5 dashboard widgets render correctly: Posture, Framework Coverage, Risk Heatmap, Compliance Trend, Control Effectiveness, Tasks, Quick Actions

frameworks_organize_panel.details: Organize panel shows all 12 frameworks with up/down arrows and eye toggle

framework_hide_show.details: Hiding a framework removes it from the grid (12 -> 11). Reset button restores all (12)

expand_all_button.details: Framework workspace shows 'Expand All' button. Clicking expands controls and changes to 'Collapse All'

collapse_all_button.details: Clicking 'Collapse All' collapses all controls and changes back to 'Expand All'

control_detail_tabs.details: Expanded control shows 4-5 tabs: Overview, Implementation & Guidelines, SIEM Evidence (for technical), Policies, Notes

implementation_guidelines_tab.details: Implementation & Guidelines tab shows 'Generate Guidance' button

implementation_guidance_api.details: POST /api/control-compliance/{fw_id}/{ctrl_id}/implementation-guidance returns implementation_steps, technical_guidelines, assessment_criteria, common_pitfalls
